product_metadata.title: suyika Tomotime Ceramic Tea Cup with Infuser and Lid Tea Mugs Wooden Handle 400ml/13.5oz Black cyan
features: Ceramic filter and lid: you can put the loose tea or tea bag inside and filter easily. The ceramic filter is healthier and tastes better than the stainless steel filter. The filter can be removed and can be washed by hand or dishwasher for easy cleaning.
Lid can be a coaster :the lid coaster just fits the size of the tea infuser when you put it up.Also it can help to keep the tea heat when you put the lid on the mug.

Anti-scalding handle: the handle is made of wood and the handle will leave more space for your hand during the process of taking the cup to prevent your hand from being scalded.But it is not recommended to put in the microwave.

Multi-functional ceramic cup: the whole body is made of ceramic and wooden handle. You can use it for tea. You can also take out the filter. Coffee, drink or water is suitable. It makes your life more simple and convenient .
Suitable for many kinds of occasions:such as office, study, balcony or in your garden, you can use our mug and have a good time.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash, Not Microwave Safe, Hand Wash Only
